translations.literal: He was changed to darughachi of the Songjiang Myriarchate and for the first time solely commanded military and civil affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to darughachi of the Songjiang myriarchate and took sole charge of military government.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，召見，遷隆興萬戶府達魯花赤，得請，復舊名曰抄兒赤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he was summoned to audience, transferred to darughachi of the Longxing Myriarchate, obtained permission, and restored his former name Chao'erchi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he was called to court, moved to Longxing myriarchate darughachi, and with permission resumed his birth name Chao'erchi.

sentences.zh: 未幾，帝以為松江瀕海重地，復命鎮之，賜三珠虎符，卒于官。

translations.literal: Before long the emperor, considering Songjiang a vital place on the sea, again ordered him to garrison it, granted a three-pearl tiger tally, and he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the emperor sent him back to Songjiang as a vital coastal post, gave him a three-pearl tiger tally, and he died in office.

sentences.zh: 帖木兒不花

translations.literal: Tiemu'erbuhua
translations.idiomatic: Tiemu'erbuhua

sentences.zh: 帖木兒不花，中統初入備宿衛。

translations.literal: Tiemu'erbuhua, at the beginning of Zhongtong, entered service as palace guard reserve.
translations.idiomatic: Tiemu'erbuhua entered the palace guard reserve at the start of Zhongtong.

sentences.zh: 至元七年，授虎符，代張馬哥為淄萊水軍萬戶，將其衆赴襄陽，與宋將范文虎戰于灌子灘，手殺四十餘人，奪其戰艦，追至雲勝洲，大敗之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Zhiyuan he was granted a tiger tally, replaced Zhang Mage as myriarch of the Zilai naval army, led his multitude to Xiangyang, and fought Song general Fan Wenhu at Guanzitan. He personally killed more than forty men, seized their warships, pursued to Yunshengzhou, and greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 7 he received a tiger tally, replaced Zhang Mage as Zilai naval myriarch, and marched to Xiangyang. At Guanzitan he fought Fan Wenhu, killed more than forty men with his own hand, seized enemy warships, pursued to Yunshengzhou, and routed the Song fleet.

sentences.zh: 行省上其功，賜白金五十兩、衣一襲、鞍轡一副。

translations.literal: The provincial administration reported his merit; he was granted fifty taels of white gold, one suit of clothing, and one set of saddle and bridle.
translations.idiomatic: The provincial administration reported his feat and he received fifty taels of white gold, a suit of clothes, and saddle gear.

sentences.zh: 九年，授益都新軍萬戶。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was appointed myriarch of the Yidu new army.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he became myriarch of the Yidu new army.

sentences.zh: 十一年，改益都、淄萊新軍萬戶。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was changed to myriarch of the Yidu and Zilai new army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was made myriarch of the combined Yidu and Zilai new army.

sentences.zh: 從丞相伯顏伐宋，敗其大將夏貴於陽羅堡。

translations.literal: He followed Chancellor Bayan in attacking the Song and defeated their great general Xia Gui at Yangluo Fort.
translations.idiomatic: He marched with Bayan against the Song and defeated Xia Gui at Yangluo Fort.

sentences.zh: 大軍渡江，論其功最多，賜白金五百兩。

translations.literal: When the great army crossed the Yangtze, his merit was judged the greatest and he was granted five hundred taels of white gold.
translations.idiomatic: When the main force crossed the Yangtze his service was judged foremost and he received five hundred taels of white gold.

sentences.zh: 又從下鄂、蘄、黃、江、建康、常、秀、蘇、杭諸郡，累加昭武大將軍。

translations.literal: He again followed in reducing E, Qi, Huang, Jiang, Jiankang, Chang, Xiu, Su, Hang, and other prefectures, and was repeatedly advanced to General of Martial Solemnity.
translations.idiomatic: He helped reduce E, Qi, Huang, Jiang, Jiankang, Chang, Xiu, Suzhou, Hangzhou, and other prefectures, rising step by step to general of martial solemnity.

sentences.zh: 從參知政事阿剌罕略定紹興、溫、台、福建諸郡，授台州路緫管府達魯花赤，遷廣東宣慰使。

translations.literal: He followed Associate Administrative Commissioner Alahan in broadly pacifying the prefectures of Shaoxing, Wen, Tai, and Fujian, was appointed darughachi of the Taizhou Circuit General Administration, and transferred to Guangdong pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned with Associate Commissioner Alahan through Shaoxing, Wenzhou, Taizhou, and Fujian, became Taizhou circuit darughachi, and was moved to Guangdong pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十六年，加都元帥。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was advanced to grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he was made grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 追宋將張世傑於香山島，世傑死，降其衆數千人。

translations.literal: He pursued Song general Zhang Shijie to Xiangshan Island; Shijie died and several thousand of his followers surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued Zhang Shijie to Xiangshan Island; Shijie died and several thousand of his men surrendered.

sentences.zh: 廣東諸郡及海島盡平，領諸降臣及將校之有功者，入見於大安閣，命太府監視其身，製銀鼠裘成，親賜予之，授中書左丞，行省江西，其餘爵賞有差。

translations.literal: The prefectures of Guangdong and the sea islands were all pacified. Leading the surrendered officials and meritorious officers and soldiers, he entered audience at the Da'an Pavilion. The emperor ordered the Imperial Storehouse to take his measurements, had a silver-marten fur coat made, and personally bestowed it on him. He was appointed Left Chancellor of the Secretariat and Jiangxi provincial commissioner; other titles and rewards varied.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangdong and its islands were pacified he led the surrendered officials and meritorious commanders to audience at the Da'an Pavilion. The emperor had the Imperial Storehouse measure him for a silver-marten coat, gave it with his own hand, and appointed him secretariat left chancellor and Jiangxi commissioner; others received lesser honors.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，拜四川等處行尚書省平章政事，兼緫軍務，改行中書省平章政事。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was appointed Pacification Commissioner of the Sichuan and other regions Branch Ministry, concurrently overseeing all military affairs, then changed to Pacification Commissioner of the Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he became pacification commissioner of the Sichuan branch ministry with overall military command, then pacification commissioner of the branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 其兄帖木脫斡，初以蒙古軍千戶從伐蜀有功，行樞密院承制授萬戶。

translations.literal: His elder brother Tiemutuwo, at first as Mongol army chiliarch followed the campaign against Shu with merit; the mobile Bureau of Military Affairs by provisional order appointed him myriarch.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother Tiemutuwo first distinguished himself as a Mongol chiliarch in the Shu campaign and was made myriarch by provisional order of the mobile Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 并將列別朮、塔海帖木兒、也速帶兒、匣剌撒兒四千戶軍，從大軍攻重慶。

translations.literal: He also commanded the four-thousand-household armies of Liebiezhu, Tahai Timur, Yesudai'er, and Xialasa'er, following the great army in attacking Chongqing.
translations.idiomatic: He also led the four-thousand-household forces of Liebiezhu, Tahai Timur, Yesudai'er, and Xialasa'er in the assault on Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 重慶降，收其衆，徇下流諸城，留鎮夔門，兼本路安撫司達魯花赤。

translations.literal: When Chongqing surrendered he gathered its forces, marched through the lower-stream cities, remained to garrison Kuimen, and concurrently served as darughachi of the circuit pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: After Chongqing surrendered he took its troops downstream, garrisoned Kuimen, and became circuit pacification darughachi.

sentences.zh: 進懷遠大將軍、蒙古軍萬戶。

translations.literal: He was advanced to General for Cherishing the Distant and myriarch of the Mongol army.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to general for cherishing the distant and Mongol army myriarch.

sentences.zh: 遷定遠大將軍，兼嘉定守鎮萬戶、本路緫管府達魯花赤。

translations.literal: He was transferred to General for Pacifying the Distant, concurrently garrison myriarch of Jiading and darughachi of the circuit general administration.
translations.idiomatic: He became general for pacifying the distant, garrison myriarch of Jiading, and circuit darughachi.

sentences.zh: 尋陞鎮國上將軍、諸蠻夷部宣慰使，加都元帥。

translations.literal: Soon he was advanced to General for Stabilizing the State and pacification commissioner of the various barbarian departments, and added grand marshal.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made general for stabilizing the state and pacification commissioner over the frontier tribes, with the added rank of grand marshal.

sentences.zh: 亦奚不薛蠻畔，與岳剌海會雲南兵討平之。

translations.literal: The Yixi Buxie barbarians rebelled; he joined Yuelahai with Yunnan troops to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yixi Buxie tribes rebelled he joined Yuelahai and Yunnan forces to crush them.

sentences.zh: 改征緬都元帥，死于軍。

translations.literal: He was changed to grand marshal for the Burma campaign and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: He was made grand marshal for the Burma campaign and died on service.

sentences.zh: 子忽都荅兒嗣。

translations.literal: His son Huducha'er inherited.
translations.idiomatic: His son Huducha'er succeeded him.
